semantic: no proposal blocker: the research questions, the within-model contribution, the method, the scope, the benchmark and the compute budget with its subsampling fallback are clear, so the verdict is ready

the unnamed model versions are not a blocker, because the methodology states a selection rule (the most recent release of one open-weight and one hosted family, documented with identifiers and access dates); listing them as a clarify-early item is acceptable, demanding them before approval is not
the industry-partner ratings are optional and RQ3 is answered from the student's own audit, so reviewer capacity and company agreements for them are not conditions of acceptance
the audit sample size is not a blocker, because it is fixed after the stated pilot audit of twenty patches
unstated execution details such as the handling of crashed or timed-out runs, what each run logs, or the test used per failure category are at most clarify-early items, each with its deferral record
